name: What are the most common hidden costs in custom home construction?

mainEntity.name: What hidden costs surprise homeowners during a custom home build?
mainEntity.text: What hidden costs surprise homeowners during a custom home build?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hidden costs usually appear when the original estimate was not detailed enough. In Los Angeles, the most common surprises are site work, permitting, utility connections, structural upgrades, drainage, retaining walls, and changes caused by design revisions or owner selections. Landscaping, appliances, lighting, and specialty finishes can also exceed allowances if the allowances were set too low. The best way to avoid surprises is to ask for a scope sheet and a list of exclusions before signing a contract. Homeowners should also keep a separate reserve for upgrades and unknown conditions, especially on hillside or older infill lots. A transparent budget is always better than a low headline price with many missing items.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common hidden costs include permits, engineering, grading, utility upgrades, temporary power, retaining walls, design changes, landscaping, fixtures beyond allowances, and city-related delays. These items can add substantially to the final budget if they are not included early.
